title: Weekend Hook Surcharge Notice — Trade-In Agreements Tows
content:
A hook surcharge applies to a tow under **Trade-In Agreements** according to the weekday of the trade's pickup date.

| Weekday of the pickup date | Hook surcharge |
|---|---|
| Sunday | $75.00 |
| Saturday | $50.00 |
| Monday to Friday | None |

The hook surcharge is added to the towing charge and forms part of the towing deduction, which is rounded to the nearest cent only at the end.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A towing charge of $149.00 on a vehicle picked up on a Sunday: $149.00 plus $75.00, which is $224.00.
- The same tow on a Saturday: $199.00.
- The same tow on a Friday: $149.00.
